segments.v: I want to talk about my friend Phương. I knew her in grade 6. She wants to be a doctor for children. She started to think about it when she was 12. Her little brother was very sick when he was born and he stayed in the hospital for many weeks. The doctors and nurses were very kind and they helped her brother. So she wants to be a doctor like them. She wants to work in a children's hospital in the countryside. She knows it is very difficult because she has to study for many years. But she studies very hard. She also volunteers at a clinic. I think she chooses this career because she likes helping people. I admire her very much.

analysis.keyDifference: Band 6 errors: “I knew her in grade 6” (We've known each other since grade 6) and “she chooses this career” (she wants to choose). Band 9 tells how the ambition began with a moving detail, explains the plan and the difficulty, and identifies the deeper motive.
